Column guide: "value" is the latest survey value and "year" its survey year. "previous_value" and
"previous_year" are the survey before it, and "change" is value minus previous_value. A column ending in
"average" is the simple average of the latest values of the countries in that group. A column named after a country
is that country's latest value, and the column ending in "year" beside it is its survey year. A column
starting "gap vs" is value minus that comparator. "region_rank" is the country's position among
"region_countries" countries in its own region, where 1 is the highest value. "obstacle_rank" ranks the
biggest-obstacle indicators within the country, where 1 is the obstacle firms name most often. "flags" are
notes produced by simple rules. Empty cells mean no data.

TASK: Read every line. Choose the 4 most interesting points for a reader who knows the region. Prefer values far from the comparators, large changes since the previous survey, and above all pairs of indicators that tell a story together or seem to contradict each other. Cover at least three different topics.

RULES:
- Use only numbers that appear in DATA, written exactly as they appear or rounded to a whole number.
  Do not calculate any new number.
- Describe what the data show. Do not claim causes.
- If a change looks too large to be plausible between two survey rounds, say in "verify" what should be
  checked. Otherwise set "verify" to an empty string.
- Plain English. Each "text" is at most 45 words. Do not put indicator codes in the text.

Return only JSON: a list of objects with the keys "headline" (at most 8 words), "text",
"indicators" (the list of indicator codes the point uses) and "verify".

checks.headline: Transportation constraints surge amid severe import delays
High innovation rates contrast with falling productivity
Permitting delays create severe regulatory hurdles
Favorable credit access eases financing constraints

points_used.headline: Transportation constraints surge amid severe import delays
points_used.text: Transportation is identified as a major constraint by 60.5% of firms, up from 19.2% in 2017 and the highest in the region. While clearing direct exports takes only 1.2 days, clearing imports requires an average of 25.9 days.
points_used.verify: Verify whether shifts in sample composition between 2017 and 2025 contributed to the sharp increase in firms identifying transportation constraints.

points_used.headline: High innovation rates contrast with falling productivity
points_used.text: Medium and large firms report regional highs in innovation, with 88.3% introducing a new product or service and 79.9% introducing process innovations. Despite this activity, real annual labor productivity growth fell to -3.3%, well below the regional average of 2.8%.

points_used.headline: Permitting delays create severe regulatory hurdles
points_used.text: Obtaining a construction permit takes an average of 179.2 days, up from 92.7 days in 2017 and far above the regional average of 80.5 days. Consequently, 44.9% of firms report business licensing and permits as a major constraint, up from 12.7%.

points_used.headline: Favorable credit access eases financing constraints
points_used.text: Access to finance was cited as the biggest obstacle by only 2.9% of firms, the lowest rate in the region. In parallel, 68.3% of firms hold a bank loan or line of credit, exceeding the regional average of 49.3%.
